$Comment: The late-campaign convergence, and the one quest that asks for a route rather than a checklist.
Requires reads as: the hive quest must be done, AND at least one of the three trade quests must
be done, AND the level floor must be met. AnyOf is how 'either road into this will do' is
written - a player who took the mining road is not sent back for the fishing one.
The steps run in order: clear the ruins first, then deliver the essence to the dunewalker.
Enabled is false, which keeps this quest out of circulation without deleting it; a player who
already holds it (none can, pre-release) could still finish it. Flip it to true, or drop the
line, once the desert campaign is ready to ship.
